review: S11 independent latest-wins and data review

focusedRun.environment: Windows x64; existing Node ABI 137 snapshot

assessment: PASS for S11 private single-controller completion-guard scope
verified: Claim captures requested revision and desired hash; the contained bounded same-handle reader supplies actual Markdown bytes and hash before processing and again before completion.
The shared publication gate spans final read and SQLite completion CAS; a separate cooperative publisher waits until the old completion ends, then its save becomes a newer desired revision.

Completion compares requested/current revision, current job identity, active requested revision, desired hash, actual file hash and cancellation state. A or B cannot complete after a newer save or clear its dirty pending job.
A file mismatch assigns one owner revision and queued job for the observed hash; repeating the old observation does not keep incrementing revision.
Rejected current completion, cancellation and failure create an enumerable retry in the same source-ledger transaction without deleting the published Markdown.

Owner startup recovers an interrupted current document job into pending work, retires an older interrupted claim without replacing a newer winner, and leaves an unrelated keyword_rebuild indexing job untouched.
The S10 retry fixture now waits for explicit failed and accepted replay events and retains its SQLite and file assertions. No public MCP or worker wire type was added.

residuals.description: The first bounded 32-job recovery page runs before START-ready. Later pages yield. FR-DOC-019 AC-9 asynchronous startup timing and a ready-before-recovery barrier remain assigned to S20 issue #43 before product cutover.
The private route assumes one live controller. Process-wide owner exclusivity and safe dead-owner recovery are explicitly assigned to S20 issue #43 before product cutover.

scopeBoundary: S11 provides a tested private completion guard and validated handoff. S12 issue #35 attaches parser/classifier/chunk/FTS writes; later producer integration and S20 owner startup controls are separate release gates. S11 does not establish public search freshness.
